instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Private K-12 school network operating 5 campuses with 3,200 enrolled students from preschool through secondary education. Following the International Baccalaureate curriculum. Evaluating adaptive learning platforms and AI-powered student progress analytics for early intervention on at-risk learners.
answers.pastInitiatives: Our engineering team adopted an agile methodology last year, moving from waterfall-style quarterly releases to 2-week sprints with continuous deployment. This reduced our release cycle time by 60% and improved cross-functional collaboration. However, adjacent teams (marketing, support) are still adapting to the faster cadence.
answers.strategicGoals: The board has mandated that 25% of revenue should come from products or services that did not exist 3 years ago. This requires us to systematically explore adjacent markets, new customer segments, and alternative monetization models. We are open to both organic build initiatives and strategic acquisitions of small, innovative companies that can serve as diversification platforms.
answers.additionalContext: The core business is stable and highly regulated by existing educational standards. However, the internal culture sometimes resists rapid change due to comfort with established processes, slowing down cross-departmental innovation initiatives.
answers.teamSize: The technology organization is structured into product-aligned squads with a central platform team of 5 engineers enabling shared infrastructure. Innovation is driven by a '20% time' policy where all engineers can dedicate one day per sprint to self-directed projects, plus a quarterly internal pitch competition where winning ideas receive seed funding and 3 months of dedicated squad allocation.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Personalized Learning Modules (LMS Enhancement)
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging existing digital maturity and AI analytics to personalize curriculum delivery for K-12 students. This is a low-risk, high-impact way to enhance the core product offering immediately.

first_actions: Pilot AI module integration in one secondary school campus
Hire 1 dedicated Data Scientist focused solely on curriculum analytics
resources_needed: 40k USD for cloud computing resources and ML tooling
20 hours/week allocation from the existing engineering squad
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase student engagement scores by 15% within one semester.
milestones: Q3: Successful pilot completion and data validation
Q4: Full rollout strategy for core product update

opportunities.title: EdTech Platform Acquisition/Spin-off for Adjacent Skill Market
opportunities.rationale: To meet the diversification mandate, we should look at acquiring a smaller EdTech firm specializing in high-demand skills like specialized coding or vocational training. This is a bold move requiring significant strategic focus but offers rapid market entry.

first_actions: Develop a target list of 5 small, niche EdTech startups
Allocate Seed funding (part of 3% budget) for initial due diligence and integration planning
resources_needed: Legal retainer for M&A advisory services
Team restructuring budget to accommodate acquired talent
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve $10M in annual recurring revenue (ARR) from the new segment within 18 months.
milestones: Q4: Finalize acquisition target and valuation
Q2 (next year): Complete integration plan with acquired entity

opportunities.title: Streamlining Parent Communication via Automated Portal
opportunities.rationale: Utilizing existing software maturity to automate the communication between teachers and parents. This addresses operational friction points, improving customer satisfaction without major tech overhauls.

first_actions: Identify top 3 pain points in current parent communication workflow
Implement automated notification system for attendance and grades
resources_needed: 15k USD for vendor API integration and custom UI development
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce support tickets related to grade/attendance inquiries by 30%.
milestones: Q3: Alpha testing with internal staff and a small cohort of parents
Q4: Full deployment across all 5 campuses

next_steps.action: Establish a dedicated M&A scouting team to identify 3 potential EdTech acquisition targets.
Finalize and resource the pilot program for AI-Driven Personalized Learning Modules.
Conduct an internal cultural assessment to identify bottlenecks hindering rapid adoption of new agile processes across support and marketing teams.

key_weaknesses: Inconsistent cross-functional process adoption, slowing down overall innovation speed.
Limited deep technical talent pool specialized in advanced AI and learning analytics within the current team structure.
Cultural resistance to rapid change among legacy operational staff.
Reliance on partial innovation processes that lack standardized governance for diverse project types.
